fork.instructions: Choose the primary path for this Thoven design request.

criteria.answer_here: Look up a specific design-system value, lock, existing component, or code-level implementation compliance. Follow the lookup and compliance reference. Visual comparison with a Paper or approved design reference belongs to design_here.
criteria.route_to_skill: A specialist concern needs deeper work, such as accessibility, copy, art, or motion craft. Whole-surface design and typography or layout in context stay here; specialist skills can support them.
criteria.needs_andres: A requested change would alter an enforced standard, introduce a hue or type role, or resize a neighbouring surface (feature-ledger rule 16). An exploratory unlocked choice can be proposed provisionally.
criteria.design_here: Design, critique, or polish a Thoven surface as a composition, including typography and layout in context, or compare the rendered implementation visually with a Paper or approved design reference. Follow the design and critique workflow in SKILL.md.

source.instructions: For a design-system lookup, which source should be opened? A colour, type, icon, or token question opens its owning code and tests before derived prose. An existence question (does this component already exist) is components_ui. This source suggestion is used only when fork is answer_here; the other paths choose their own references.

criteria.colour_palette: The question is which colour, hue, palette, or status colour to use. Open tools/build-palette.mjs (PALETTE) and __tests__/palette.test.ts.
criteria.type_ramp: Type ramp, fonts, weights. Open app/globals.css type roles, __tests__/type-roles.test.ts and lib/cn-type-roles.test.ts; role selection in design/typography.md.
criteria.buttons: Buttons, ledges, variants. Open thovenButtonTokens in lib/live-lesson-tokens.ts and components/ui/thoven-button.tsx.
criteria.icons: Icons and the two tiers. Open lib/icon-tokens.ts and the icon tests.
criteria.motion: Motion, springs, reduced motion. Open lib/motion-config.ts.
criteria.layout: Layout, viewport, spacing. Open design/layout.md; consult the implementation reference for current Linear rulings.
criteria.lexicon: What a thing is called. Open design/lexicon/LEXICON.md in the frontend repo.
criteria.components_ui: Does a component already exist? Dialog, sheet, popover, primitive. Open components/ui/ (primitives only).
criteria.stack_md: Could a user name it, build or take, Interior vs base-ui. Open design/STACK.md rule 7 in the frontend repo.
criteria.design_md: A declared lock, a divergence row, or intent with no token module. Open DESIGN.md.
